topic: Effect of propeller rotation on aircraft and methods used to counteract it
syllabus_extract: Effect of propeller rotation on aircraft and methods used to counteract it
specific_objectives: 12.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe the various types of propellers, principles of operation and pitch change mechanisms.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of P-Yaw and P-Roll diagrams; Instructor supervision on theoretical application only
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a propeller?
Define P-Yaw and P-Roll in the context of propeller rotation.
Which aircraft systems are typically used to counteract P-Yaw?

development.content:
Principles of P-Yaw generation
Principles of P-Roll generation
Aerodynamic causes of asymmetry
Impact on aircraft stability
Role of slipstream asymmetry

Function of P-Yaw countermeasure
Function of P-Roll countermeasure
Trimming procedures for P-Yaw
Trimming procedures for P-Roll
Effect of engine power changes

Operational limits for countermeasures
Maintenance checks for trim systems
Troubleshooting P-Yaw issues
Troubleshooting P-Roll issues
Safety considerations during trim

summary_questions: Explain how P-Yaw affects the aircraft's directional stability.
Describe the mechanism used to counteract P-Roll in flight.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the constructional details of the Dornier aircraft propeller, focusing on blade construction and pitch change mechanisms, to be covered in LP 05.

pft_rows.syllabus: Constructional details about Dornier A/C propeller, construction of blades and pitch change mechanism and spinner
